en: "Affinities and Weaknesses"{SAUT}All attacks have an {f 0 1 2}affinity{f 0 1 0}, such as Fire,{SAUT}and enemies may be {f 0 1 2}weak{f 0 1 0} against them.
Attack with an enemy's weakness in mind,{SAUT}and you will deal massive damage, as well{SAUT}as force your unlucky foe into a {f 0 1 2}Down{f 0 1 0} state.

"Downed Enemies and All-out Attacks"{SAUT}Downed enemies will take their turns last{SAUT}in each round of combat. If all of them are{SAUT}down, you'll have the chance for an{f 0 1 2}All-{SAUT}out Attack,{f 0 1 0} which is the perfect{SAUT}opportunity for you to do some extreme damage!

"Target Information"{SAUT}As you toggle between enemies, useful{SAUT}info will appear above them: A {f 0 1 2}WEAK{f 0 1 0}{SAUT}icon will be displayed if your attack's{SAUT}affinity has, in past battles, proven to be{SAUT}strong against that enemy type. If, on the{SAUT}other hand, your attack's affinity has{SAUT}never been used on the enemy before, a{SAUT}{f 0 1 2}no data{f 0 1 0} icon will be displayed.
To make it easy, each teammates' chosen{SAUT}attack type will be displayed above the{SAUT}target cursor.
Try out attacks with differing affinities on{SAUT}each new enemy you encounter, so you{SAUT}can learn what they're weak against!
